visual_summary: A small armored figure in a vast metallic interior decides to act without force, miming the draw of a bow or using a rod-like instrument to produce a musical note. The sound calms a white-blue octo-tiger creature, which relaxes, curls up, and falls asleep. The figure keeps playing as the beast snores, then moves onward across the enormous chamber toward an opening or passage.
